features.covers: the Cat tab for a living cat: a large live room pinned at the top (both cats, on the phone's own autopilot), the cat's card (name, hearts, mood, bond, a kitten's growth line, last meal, meals today, days together, favourite place and toy, the hint), Feed and Slow blink, and the Care and settings card (Vacation mode, Rename); with pet.panels.v1 (CT6 part A) also the mind row in the cat's card (bond style, mood, while you were away), the Together card with the switcher between two cats, and the collapsible cards of what the cat likes, its inner life, its genetics (read only, the genome table on request) and the toy list with the Rewards shop's early unlock. With pet.touch.v1 (CT2) the cats answer a finger by themselves (tap, hold-stroke and drag-through petting, with hearts, purr, ears and haptics), a tap on the bowl feeds, and the room opens full screen on the screen's own. Steps aside for the intro (no cat yet), the memorial (a cat that has passed), the page's full-screen room (an older screen only), a level-up and a visit the owner handed to the page. The cats are not the page's cats in this release: no play or pair until the brain link (CT3)

commands.feed: {op}: the page's own petFeedClick (one cat, or whoever is hungry of two, with the second cat's runtime made first) once the page's gate says a meal is due; ok only when every write reached storage (the save's answer), else the cats are taken back and the reply says the page's unsavedMessage(); a repeat of an operation that landed answers changed:false 'Already recorded.' (kept for the session, 40 operations); a refusal answers {ok:false, why:'full'|'vacation', inHours, message} in the page's words (petFeedRefusal) and, when full, reaction 'bowl' (the cat goes to its bowl to wash, as the page's does); the meal arrives as the fed cue of the next projection, one per cat fed, which the room plays once
commands.blink: {}: the page's petBlinkClick for the cat whose card shows; the page's refusal (asleep, or a third blink in six seconds) arrives as the message from its toast, taken so no screen shows it twice; else reaction 'blink' and the screen's cat blinks back. Writes nothing
commands.vacation: {on}: petSetVacation for both cats as the page's switch does; the state asked for again answers changed:false 'Already recorded.'; a value that is not a boolean is refused; ok only once stored, else taken back
commands.rename: {name}: petRename for the cat whose card shows; 1 to 14 characters after trimming (a name that is not text, empty or longer is refused); the same name answers changed:false 'Already recorded.'; ok only once stored, else taken back
commands.focus: {i} (pet.panels.v1): the Together card's switcher: petPairFocus(i) for 0 or 1; the same cat answers changed:false 'Already recorded.'; cat 1 with one cat, or any other value, is refused in words; nothing is written (the focus is the page's view state)
commands.buyToy: {id} (pet.panels.v1): unlock a toy early with Sparks by the Rewards shop's own rule (ecoBuy('toy', id): price ECO_TOY_PRICE, balance, the save); only toys with a price are for sale; ok only once the save stored it, else Sparks and toysBought are taken back and the reply says the page's unsavedMessage(); a toy already bought answers changed:false 'Already recorded.' and costs nothing; too few Sparks is the shop's own refusal ('Not enough Sparks'); the shop's toast is the reply's message, taken so no screen shows it twice
commands.expand: {open} (pet.panels.v1): the full genome table (about forty rows) is in the projection only while open (30 minutes at most); a value that is not a boolean is refused; nothing is written

commands.touch: (capability pet.touch.v1) two kinds, each with {cat}: `stroke {op, cat, heldMs, left:''|'over'|'shy', ignored, spam, keepSleep}` is a touch that ended, which the page judges by its own rules: the brain's saturation (PET_BRAIN.SAT_TAP on landing, SAT_HOLD a second held, less for a trusting cat and a sleeping one, worn off by the clock), its events (startle for a stranger, spam, pet_beat, overstim), and a pet counted by petPetDone when the finger stayed 1.1 s and the cat did not leave (three a day, +2 bond); the reply is {ok, changed (a pet counted), message (the page's level-up words), levelUp (the level reached, 0 for none)}, ok only once stored, else the cats are taken back; a repeat of an operation answers changed:false 'Already recorded.'; a field of the wrong kind, an unknown cat or no operation is refused. `purr {cat, on, level}` starts or stops the page's purr sound (the page feeds its purr loop on a 100 ms timer while the screen covers the room loop, and stops it when the screen closes); writes nothing. petLikesPetted is not called (it needs the cat's spot, which the page does not know until CT3)
commands.world: (capability pet.world.v1, CB0) {op, epoch, rev, blob}: stores native's opaque cat world blob as state.petWorld = {epoch, rev, at, op, blob} with writeSave() (50-native-cat-world.js); checks, in order: the shape (exactly these keys, an op of 1 to 80 [A-Za-z0-9:._-], whole numbers, rev >= 1, blob an object with an integer v from 1 to 1 and cats keyed by exactly the living cats' ids c<born base36>), the size (the blob's JSON at most 8 KB), then staleness (epoch equal to the page's world epoch, rev above the stored one). Never reads inside the blob. Reply {ok, changed, message, why: ''|'shape'|'size'|'stale'|'unsaved', epoch (the page's), rev (the stored one, 0 for none)}; ok only once stored, a refused save is taken back; a repeat of a landed op (kept in memory and with the stored world) answers ok, changed:false, 'Already recorded.'; refused as 'shape' for a screen without pet.world.v1. A backup restore (applyBackup) raises the world epoch, kept in localStorage lifemax_pet_world_epoch_v1 beside the save (not in backups, so a backup comes back exactly as made). CB2: sent by the cat world host (feature/pet/host, CatWorldHost/WorldSync) with op 'world:<epoch>:<rev>', the blob's outbox carrying the commands native has not had answered (at most 16); a repeat after a lost reply answers 'Already recorded.', a refused save is not remembered as landed so the same op stores once storage works; stale names the page's epoch and stored rev, which native adopts

commands.today: {name, ...payload, op} (phase 4A, director.sheets.v1): Today's writes done {id, minutes?}, logToday {id, minutes, op}, skip {id}, pin {id, on}, moveTo {id, start}, timer {act, id, start?}; ok only once saved; a repeat of one that landed answers ok, changed:false, 'Already recorded.' or 'Already skipped.'; the screen keeps an operation id per (command, target) until a terminal reply. director.remove.v1 (Native API 50) adds: every session row of today.rows carries remove {ok, reason} (reason non-empty when ok is false: a session done, part done, off the plan, or on a running timer), and today unskip {id, op}. Removing a session from a day is the page's own skip (the engine's SKIPPED trigger with its miss consequence and re-plan; that occurrence only, never the recurring rule; no XP); a skip that landed answers changed:true and undo: the page's words, and the page keeps that one skip (the plan and ledger as they were, and the plan as the skip left it, in memory, two minutes) so unskip puts both back exactly, only while nothing else has changed the plan (else ok:false, nothing changed); a repeat of unskip by op, or for a session already on the plan, answers ok, changed:false, 'Already back on the plan.'; a failed save answers ok:false 'Not saved: ...' and the same request lands it. skip of a session on a running timer is refused ('Its timer is running. Stop the timer first.'). A page that does not see director.remove.v1 and director.sheets.v1 sends no remove fields and refuses unskip

Native then draws the room itself: the house (the three painted rooms, the sky behind each window by the device's local hour, window light, the bed, bowls, props, the time-of-day tint and the lamp's glow) with the cats living in it on local autopilots that walk between the rooms, eat, sleep on the bed, sit on the sofa, climb the cat tree and watch from the window sill, keep a polite distance, and are followed by an easing camera; it keeps the still portrait with the switch off, if the first cat cannot go live (no art, a genetic coat the page refuses) or if the art does not load. A second cat that cannot go live is simply not drawn. The four legacy coats draw at once. A genetic dna_ coat draws only when the handshake also lists overview.cat.coat.v1 (Native API 47) and the page holds the coat (either cat's): native asks the page for its sheets with the coat command (adult first, then the depth view; a kitten's stage sheets), caches them by key, shows the still portrait until the first cat's adult sheet is in, and keeps it for good if the page refuses. plugins.NativeNutrition: capabilities() answers swipe: 2 (1 was phase 1 only); the swipe event adds the screen session, and a swipeSettle naming another session is ignored; open takes enter and velocity as above; its screen takes the pane title "Food" on open; it has no prime (its snapshot is a session of its own)

refusals.off: the swipe is not on: the switch or Swipe to switch tabs off, onboarding not done, the thumbnail pass running, or a view a swipe never starts from (Life Director)
refusals.overlay: a popup or sheet over the page (lmaTopOverlay), a body that must not scroll, or a lock cover
refusals.stale: not from the open screen of the view the page is on (a Food screen session that has ended included), or to is not the tab next to it, dir ±1, on the bar as it is now
refusals.kind: Money (a stop), or a tab the page draws when the swipe does not carry reveal: true (an APK from phase 1)
refusals.error: the decision threw; nothing else is done

features.tune: defaults in SwipeTune.kt, mirrored by LMA_TABSWIPE and held equal by SwipeTuneTest (fixtures/swipe-tune.json, written from the page); the owner's changes (Developer mode, Swipe feel (testing); lmaLoad().swipeTune) ride swipe.tune and native clamps each key: knee 0.05–0.35, breakAt knee + 0.10–0.70, heavy 0.05–1, hyst 0–0.15, popDamping 0.4–1, popStiffness 400–3000, wallMax 0–0.15, wallSlope 0–0.6, flingDp 500–3000, flingMin 0.05–0.35, backFlingDp 200–2000, commitK and cancelK 300–4000, slopFactor 1–2 (never under the platform's slop, where a child scroller claims), lockRatio 1–3, edgeDp 16–48, haptic threshold | tick | click | off
features.sourceRule: NativeLifeDirector is never a source (swipeSource = false; its section swipe and dial handles are its own); it can be a destination
features.rollout: Settings, Navigation: Native tab swipe (beta), off by default

prime.caller: NativePrime (50-native-prime.js): after 800 ms with no touch, the swipe on and nothing over the page, the first never-primed native neighbour of the current tab that has a kit with prime: true, then the next after another 800 ms; a busy answer is asked again up to 6 times per page load, a rejection never twice
prime.refusals: composed (the screen exists already: counted as primed), busy (a swipe or hand-over in flight)
prime.tabs: character, log, plan, library (media); not the Journal (private), Life Director (it covers only some of its view), Food (its own plugin) or Recipes (not a bar neighbour)

features.chained: a finger that lands on a screen still sliding takes hold of it (SwipeInput.Catch): a cancel springing back, or a commit whose hand-over is done (the destination open and drawn, the source closed); never a commit still waiting for the page. The drag continues through the inverse of the curve (TensionCurve.invertHold, Tension.holding)

features.pluginSource: bridge/web/NativeAudioPlugin.kt (a plain Plugin, not a tab)
features.screenSource: app/shell/audio/AudioDock.kt, AudioDockHost.kt (one view owned by the shell, above the bottom bar of whichever native screen shows)
features.webModule: 50-native-audio.js (setting nativeAudio, Native audiobook controls (beta), off by default)
features.covers: every native screen under the shared bars, and the Overview's own bars; not a view the page draws (there the page's own player stays); not while the keyboard is up; Cash has none

commands.rate: {value}: one of the page's #audioRate options; sets it and calls audioSetRate

readContract.decoder: AudioDockState.decode (strict: v must be 1, every key present and of its kind; the colours only while visible)
readContract.payload: NativeAudio.state({v:1, visible, minimized, loading, mediaId, title, sub, playing, position, duration, rate, rates, tokens, light}); position and duration are seconds; native extrapolates between pushes and ticks once a second only while the seek bar is on screen and moving
readContract.events: the page pushes on play, pause, seeked, ratechange, loadedmetadata, durationchange, ended, emptied, on the player's class changes and on lma-audio (a file starting to load), and every 10 s while playing; native tells the page {shown, height} (dock event) when the dock shows, goes or changes height
readContract.invalidation: none beyond the pushes: the page stays the player; position persistence stays the page's (persistAudioPosition)

features.mutationsGate: no native writes: every command runs the page's own player function; the position and the file stay the page's (IndexedDB)
features.rollout: Classic is default; the dock is opt-in. With it on and the handshake carrying shell.audio.v1, native Media and the Journal no longer step aside for a loaded book
